title: Dan's earlier group the Dolphins and live-to-two-track DMP records
summary: Dan recalls the Dolphins with Mike DeMicco, complicated arrangements and DMP records made live with no overdubbing.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: You know you should go back further and talk about the Dolphins.
Well yeah I mean I’ve had different groups.
Oh you did? Huh in Utica. Yeah. I’m trying to remember the club.

Tiny’s there we go. Yeah in that group, Mike was in that group too, the guitar player that played last night. And that was an interesting band because you know it was like a far cry away from anything I had really done. So I had to kind of discipline myself to really play parts. And there was a lot of complicated music in that.

Yeah just ridiculous arrangements and very tight. And all the records we did were with DMP and that was live to two track. So when you hear those records I think the most amazing thing is to know that it’s all live.
